title: Wire rooted Core.Collections backing storage
body:
The read-only implementation audit and validated `complete-v0-4-corelib-runtime-contracts` OpenSpec change are complete. Production implementation has not begun. The required design hard-cuts public APIs to `Core.Collections.*`, retains direct bounds-checked ISLE indexing as the sole Get/Set path, and adds one manifest-owned rooted typed-grow operation; it explicitly does not add `array_get`/`array_set` ABI symbols or preserve `Collections.*` aliases. Correctness also requires specialization-aware array/aggregate descriptors, managed aggregate construction roots, and pointer-store barriers.

## Sequencing

Blocked on a fresh 61/61 Corelib matrix and the aggregate rooting/barrier prerequisite.

**Linear:** [CYB-184](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-184/v04-implement-rooted-corecollections-backing-storage)

subtasks.text: Hard-cut Core.Collections APIs and behavior tests
